GraceChangeDesignContext.Rationale: This is the decisive product test rather than another horizontal subsystem. It operationalizes generate, validate, test, activate, monitor, and rollback without granting the builder or feature administrative authority.

Alternatives.Alternative: Open arbitrary generated features after unit tests of each subsystem. Rejected because composition failures and privilege paths would remain untested.
Use a builtin trusted demo feature. Rejected because it would not test the ordinary untrusted package and permission path.

DeferredDecisions.Decision: The feature UX wording and visual polish are deferred; the security and recovery journey is normative.
Model generation may use a deterministic fixture initially, but generated output must traverse the same builder and validator boundary.

Scenarios.Scenario: The user asks for a page-outline sidebar, reviews its narrow page-read and UI-slot permissions, activates it, and optionally grants one typed navigation action.
A bad revision loops during startup; monitoring quarantines it, rolls back the full generation, and trusted browsing remains available after restart.
